## Latest public-write comparison — exact pre-sprint and ordinary sources

The merged allocation candidate has now been compared with the exact pre-sprint source and ordinary control using the unchanged public `BenchmarkConditionalTxnBaselineBatchWrite` fixture. [All nine raw samples, source/binary identities, commands and receipts](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/tree/514dab33ef07ab09cacb89efd862043a59f15318/artifacts/4871/20261015-allocation-triad) are published and read back; the coordinator independently recomputed the medians.

| Source | ns/op | operations/s | B/op | allocations/op |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Pre-sprint `28aea01e` | 45,144 | 22,151 | 152,663 | 281 |
| Ordinary `177fb0c8` | 47,476 | 21,063 | 154,839 | 286 |
| Combined `a22078f5` | 21,314 | 46,918 | 31,943 | 127 |

Combined versus pre-sprint: **52.79% less time, 79.08% fewer bytes and 54.80% fewer allocation objects**. Versus ordinary: 55.11%, 79.37% and 55.59% respectively. These are combined measurements; component percentages are not added. Candidate `a22078f5` and merged `5bca87ff` have the same entire Git tree.

Three rotating fixed-1,000-write samples per source, Go1.26.3/Linux111, CPU0/GOMAXPROCS1. The unchanged default-engine fixture seeds 10,000 keys and checkpoints every eight writes with the timer stopped; final partial-group Close is outside timing. Timed groups assert no intervening root publication, and checkpoints assert debt is drained. Source/binary censuses match before and after. All planned samples are retained; no reruns or diagnostic instrumentation. Boundary snapshots showed no competing Go/benchmark/profile process, without claiming continuous host monitoring.

This closes the missing **short** exact-baseline/pre-sprint comparison. Full eight-repeat micro, matched M0/Dgraph sprint targets and native ACK/Q32 acceptance remain open in #4878/#4879. #5130 remains open for finite shared native/ordinary integration evidence; full #4878 acceptance is not a prerequisite for closing #5130. Native construction continues concurrently.

The arena-first workflow is installed and [skills PR #25](https://github.com/snissn/skills/pull/25) is merged as `e8a56cdd`. Its [Go performance skill](https://github.com/snissn/skills/blob/e8a56cddb57d078564f09895b7e0a67fa74f49ea/go-performance-optimization/SKILL.md) requires reuse of suitable maintained arenas/buffers, last-consumer/reset/retention checks, and a documented contract or measured reason for alternatives. An exception does not waive public performance evidence.


Earlier measurements and checkpoints follow; the exact three-way result above supersedes their pending pre-sprint comparison statements.

### Latest allocation delivery — merged 2026-10-15

**Delivered:** [PR #5135](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/pull/5135) merged as `5bca87ffe6e1bfba2d693264d2dc82936adc234f` from final head `a22078f59bfe9023787d5147c51c989a4010644d`. All **51** current-head checks passed, including TreeDB, platforms/race and the unchanged M0 gate. Hosted Codex completed clean; CodeRabbit findings were dispositioned and every thread resolved. The finalizer and coordinator independently verified all **31** changed blobs in merged main. #5131 and #5132 are closed; #5133 was already delivered by PR #5134.

[Final CI/review/merge and independent readback evidence](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/tree/c0a1b9459e5b313265a71653ef1e7f415469cdb7/artifacts/4871/20261015-allocator-repair/merged-5bca) is durable. The measured production/public-benchmark inputs at `7702c2a2` are identical to final `a22078f5`; its additional commit changes only the snapshot fixture. The final head's M0 run `38691793798` passed. The earlier `7702` foreground-p99 variance failure is retained; its unchanged-head retry was cancelled by the subsequent push, so no completed retry or unrelated-flake claim is made.

The repaired matched public comparison remains **141,463 → 31,944 B/op**, **269 → 127 allocations/op**, and **45,212 → 21,356 ns/op** over three alternating fixed-1,000-write pairs. Both builds include the same root-lifetime repair and merged zipper; timing is directional. This accepts the scoped component delivery and measured allocation reductions. The original pre-sprint comparison, M0/Dgraph sprint targets and native production ACK/Q32 requirements remain open in #4878/#4879; these short component runs do not satisfy them. The same canonical allocator has been projected into the native owner with focused classifier/pin controls passing, while actual bounded activation and ordinary backintegration remain that owner's responsibility.

Earlier candidate measurements and historical checkpoints follow. Their pending-delivery statements are superseded by the exact merged status above.

MVCC sprint performance scorecard — maintained evidence summary, 2026-10-15

**Measured improvement, sprint acceptance still open.** The allocator plus merged zipper candidate cuts public batch-write allocation sharply and improves short-run time. This establishes a scoped measured gain; original pre-sprint/M0/Dgraph and bounded native ACK/Q32 qualification remain open. The last bounded native production attempt still has ACK0.

**Latest repaired candidate (2026-10-15):** [PR #5135](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/pull/5135), head `7702c2a28f9c45266977ec708688717f4e19fd6a`.

| Median | Matched baseline | Repaired allocator + zipper | Change |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| B/op | 141,463 | 31,944 | -77.42% |
| allocations/op | 269 | 127 | -52.79% |
| ns/op | 45,212 | 21,356 | -52.76% |

Three alternating fixed-1,000-write public `Batch.Write` pairs; timing remains directional. Both builds retain merged zipper main `9029eb4e` **and the same new root-lifetime repair**. The baseline restores 17 allocator Go inputs, so the recovery fix cannot explain the measured allocator difference. Full Go/module input census stays unchanged. [Raw pairs, runner/overlay, exact hashes, RED/normal/race and independent review evidence](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/blob/fad5aad24cd72d190e67df2e1475a23ec99adb9d/artifacts/4871/20261015-allocator-repair/README.md) are pushed and read back.

Public SetSync RED exposed premature reuse of a root record still referenced by the surviving recovery slot. The repair retains it through the **actual successor CommitSeq**; format-config consumers, fresh IgnoreFormatConfig and the index-only snapshot fixture are repaired coherently. Four focused normal commands and the focused race pass. Independent GPT-6.1 Sol review accepts all 16 repair blobs; 15 original allocator paths remain unchanged, with renewed review of the other three. No recovery assertions or performance thresholds were weakened.

**Remaining merge gates:** sole finalizer `/root/allocation_zipper_5133_sol61` owns current-head required CI, review, merge and changed-file readback. The first exact-head M0 run failed only its foreground-p99 variance criterion; one unchanged-head failed-job rerun is underway, retaining the first result. This variance failure is not yet classified as unrelated noise. #5131/#5132 and tracker acceptance stay open until delivery gates pass. Original pre-sprint/M0/Dgraph and native production ACK/Q32 sprint qualification remain open; native architecture work continues in parallel.

**Fresh production result:** direct production `PruneVersions`, Q32/1MiB,1024 persisted pointer rows, actual multileaf DATA/combinedV2/LZ4 and exactly one legal pre-ACK CommitAt: **ACK0**, writes1/prepared140/cut0. **479,495ns is time to refusal, NOT ACK latency. Allocation NOT_COLLECTED** (logged zero fields are not0B/0alloc). The original work-bearing caller guard refused at phase16. Checked cursor Close and DB.Close failed; reopen not reached. Compiled outer-allocation test was not run after failure. [Frozen report, exact commands/source bindings/raw results](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/blob/20976a205c3d0d14fc571279e21d66d11f14e3e0/artifacts/4871/20261015-native-allocation-attribution/packet/report.md).

**Fresh attribution, explicitly UNBOUNDED DIAGNOSTIC:** separately named/directly selected operation completed ACK1, writes1/prepared90/cut0, actual0xf044 output leaves and shared DATA; old/current/future/post-ACK write/checked Close/reopen passed. No fallback. Rate1 profiling/GC-conditioned timing is excluded from latency claims. Allocation snapshots bracket only the public sequence; seeding/Stats/serialization are outside. Root independently recomputed both snapshots, aggregating size-distinct runtime buckets before subtraction; no negative deltas.

| Measured caller category | Bytes | Objects |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Prune public stack | **2,674,568** | **1,102** |
| One ordinary CommitAt public stack |9,344|81|
| Unclassified/window-unproven |6,976|16|
| All deltas |2,690,888|1,199|

| Cold LZ4 scratch |139,264|1|

The first three total **1,908,736B:71.12% of proven public-entry bytes**. Object-count leaders differ: OrdinalScanWork142objects/15,904B and resource wrappers84objects/6,720B. `Manager.currentSetLocked` is4,224B/6objects here, not the dominant byte source. Missing public stack frames remain unclassified, not automatically background.

**Measured structural optimization — COMPLETE as a scoped WIP checkpoint:** one admitted LeafAppendWork now belongs to the SAME MaterializedWriteWork, with explicit active-target binding. Replaced redundant per-frame workspaces while retaining original owner/admission and all wrapper/cache-result pauses. Metadata reset retains compressor arrays; no large per-leaf zeroing. [Source `d7c27d78`](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/commit/d7c27d7829e51ad06822340fcc55f03c3831f027) · [raw results, exact sources, commands and receipt](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/blob/2a62b172a0f66a5c38698e40d9abcc7f0f2ba66c/artifacts/4871/20261015-native-shared-append-workspace/README.md).

| Matched completed UNBOUNDED DIAGNOSTIC cell | Before | After | Change |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Whole sequence allocated bytes |2,506,920|2,202,184|**−304,736 (−12.16%)**|
| Whole sequence allocated objects |1,195|1,195|0|
| Clean first-call-to-ACK wall |1.106271ms|1.051380ms|−4.96%, **one pair only**|
| Sum of prune-call time |1.022150ms|0.966589ms|−5.44%, **one pair only**|

Exactly one intervening write,90 prepared observations, ACK1, actual combinedV2/LZ4/packed output0xf044, shared36of37 original children and old/current/post-ACK/checked Close/reopen checks pass in each cell. Allocation uses separately invoked processwide outer counters including that write/runtime. Clean latency runs do not collect allocation; their zero fields mean NOT_COLLECTED. These cells use the identical harness before/after and differ from the earlier Rate1 attribution run. Do not subtract across those differently instrumented runs.

Focused runtime RED→GREEN verifies actual workspace identity through serial outputs and hook/cache-result/reset refusals. Active-target Cancel honestly refuses while retaining aliases/charge; terminal physical abandonment remains WIP. The completed diagnostic exercises real configured output, while the focused bounded producer test models physical wrapper pauses. **Neither establishes bounded production ACK/Q32 or sprint speedup.** Source4399rows unchanged within each run; root independently verified raw results, all4 source blobs, finite45-member artifact and both retained binary identities.

Read-only review found cursor/projection retained aliases and overlapping liveness; no safer higher-ROI buffer union. These are per-cursor/per-output capacities, not per-resume churn. **Next critical path:** actual production typed Set/fresh publication binding/original Finish, then immediate clean public latency and outer allocation. No new diagnostic allocation loop or broad correctness expansion before production viability. Focused checks remain required; exhaustive final qualification and serious known failures remain binding.

**Original sprint baseline remains binding.** Last full matched pre-sprint micro comparison: ordinary `a934ea4c`, pre-sprint `28aea01e`, recent main `3f87d74b`; Go1.26.3/CPU0/GOMAXPROCS1/two balanced samples. This source predates shared integration and differs from the fresh native tree. [Full pre/main/candidate table and raw packet](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/4871#issuecomment-6182136880).

Reader p50/allocations improve in all four. Scoped gains, not overall acceptance.

The earlier one-write ~0.94ms/2.007MB diagnostic used different source/per-call observers; it is not a before/after comparison with this fresh allocation probe. Whole-harness setup profiles likewise do not substitute current-window attribution.

### Direct profiles and parallel allocation work — 2026-10-15

Root verified all65 published members against retained raw evidence. Ordinary source177fb0c8; native frozen d7c27d78 diagnostic binary includes documented foreign2 compiler inputs, not a clean Git-only reproduction.

Exact public `db.(*Batch).Write`:3.86s/386samples; allocator Prepare54.92%, nested Materialize48.45%, overlapping mallocgc33.68%. Exact Write allocation464,099,984B: flat encodeIndex42.79%, cloneStateNode11.31%, stateChunk.clone9.05%, newMergeScratch7.18%, encodeChunk5.71%. Cumulative encoding57.23%, cloning20.35%; cumulative groups overlap and must not be added. Setup WriteSync and stopped-timer Checkpoint stacks excluded, but fixture allocator history remains. Single profiled ns/op is not comparable to qualification runs.

Native unbounded diagnostic public prune frame only0.92s/92samples: finalizeLocked61.96%, nested resource capture33.70% and external scan31.52%, mallocgc20.65% overlap. Whole16.05s profile is setup-heavy. This ranks broad diagnostic paths only; future bounded production CPU remains unmeasured.150-fixture foreground mutex476,294ns/block331,443ns; whole block36.535s mostly idle/waits, not latency.

GetVersioned and SnapshotSeek remain0B/0alloc. Get snapshot-acquire/close56.22% and mutex/atomicCPU30.60% overlap; this is mostly uncontended CPU, not lock wait. Seek node-load/child-view paths dominate, with value-copy hypothesis still unisolated. These do not resolve original concurrent cached writeMu contention.

User requested parallel implementation: [tracker#5130](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5130), [topology/encoding#5131](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5131), [private cloning#5132](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5132), [zipper scratch#5133](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5133). Separate active Sol6.1 writers, one canonical allocator interface, serial runtime windows, reuse paused R1 source deliberately. Private/public activation regressions exercised; source-bound measured component gains below. Native original Set/binding/Finish remains concurrent priority. This explicitly supersedes the older no-additional-allocation-loop scheduling note, without changing any correctness or final numerical gate.

## Native shared encoder — ordinary allocation regression corrected

[Coherent source and evidence](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/tree/669ca698fe9baf31f8fb910f5c7b8de0eb196a03/artifacts/4871/20261015-native-retained-emission) now preserve the original failed experiment and its correction. This is a short public foreground guard on native-source `353a88fb`, separate from the pre-sprint/ordinary/merged-main triad above.

| Median | Baseline353 | Corrected shared encoder |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| ns/op | 25,576 | 25,902 |
| B/op | 46,330 | 46,298 |
| allocations/op | 148 | 147 |

All six planned fixed-1,000-write samples passed with no reruns; latency +1.275% passes the <=5% guard, and bytes/objects decrease. The unchanged public fixture, Go1.26.3/CPU0/GOMAXPROCS1 and checkpoint boundaries are source-bound. Root independently recomputed every raw sample. The original refactor failed allocations (+136 B/+1 object) despite acceptable timing; compiler escape evidence identified retained ordinary-call operands. The fix drains the SAME encoding core with stack controls for ordinary calls; focused RED3 -> GREEN1 required output allocation and independent review pass. Existing arenas/buffers remain the default where lifetimes fit; retained writer page views and persistent COW outputs cannot be reset at a batch boundary.

Finalizer read back every new blob; root independently verified 16 critical files and all 246 changed Git blob identities. This is a non-PR WIP component checkpoint, not native or final sprint acceptance. Actual native ACK remains 0. The native owner is now closing the SAME constructor/reservation stages, starting by removing page-list expansion used only to count existing normalized ranges. An isolated ordinary lane will consume the already merged canonical allocator and zipper with a short public comparison before exhaustive qualification.
